race.comment: Tough with most on debut and a few looking quite handy, with a couple of likely chances coming out. FONTANA DI TREVI (10) is a well-bred filly by Blue Point on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard. She's been right there in a couple of jumpouts and draws well, expect she's ready to go for a yard who prepare them well. BUSHRA (9) is a well-bred filly by St Mark's Basilica for the Dom Sutton yard. She's been jumping out very well and should take plenty of beating, watch the market. VELLA LONGA (6) was good on debut at Sale when showing speed and sticking on for fourth. Better for that and should go close. PAIN AU CHOCOLAT (13) resumes having run on well on debut at Cranbourne, look for her late.
